title: A3 consolidate resolved primitive SDF emission
description:
## User Mandate

> "Carefully review the latest work and this external audit/task plan and implement the next set of tasks."

STRICT. Binding constraints:
- Keep one concrete implementation for resolved shape to primitive, transform, bounds, cullability, and symmetry emission.
- Preserve the authoritative CreatureDefinition and detached resolved snapshot boundary.
- Preserve deterministic operation data and documented ellipsoid culling behavior.
- Do not introduce a generic SDF compiler framework or new IR.

## Summary

Consolidate the mechanically duplicated resolved primitive emission used by whole-creature and individual-part portable SDF compilation.

## Scope

- Extract one small concrete helper for resolved shape mapping, parameter packing, primitive creation, transform wrapping, bounds, cullability, and symmetry wrapping.
- Keep limb chain emission separate.
- Compare whole-creature and individual-part operation data for Sphere, Capsule, Box, Ellipsoid, and mirrored variants.
- Preserve native disposal and existing public APIs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Whole-creature and individual-part compilation use the same resolved primitive emission implementation.
- Operation parameters, transforms, bounds, cullability, symmetry, and deterministic order remain unchanged.
- Ellipsoid operations remain non-cullable while ordinary primitives remain cullable.
- Focused parity tests pass.

## Validation

Run the focused runtime SDF builder tests, affected runtime build, Unity PlayMode tests when available, and git diff --check.

## Findings

A3 inventory found duplicate primitive blocks in SdfProgramBuilder.CompilePortable and CompilePortablePart. Both independently map ResolvedShape to SdfOperationType and parameters, append Transform, set bounds/cullability, and append Symmetry.

## Blockers

None known.

## Next Step

Extract the concrete helper, add operation-data parity coverage, and validate the touched runtime slice.

comments.body:
Implementation evidence (2026-09-05): SdfProgramBuilder now has one concrete AppendResolvedPrimitive helper for ResolvedShape -> primitive type/parameters, transform, distance scale, world bounds, cullability, and optional symmetry. CompilePortable and CompilePortablePart delegate to it; limb chain emission remains separate. No public API or snapshot boundary changes.

Validation evidence: focused Unity PlayMode parity test CompilePortable_AndIndividualPartCompilationSharePrimitiveOperationData passed 1/1. Existing SdfProgramBuilderTests fixture passed 19/19 in PlayMode. Unity console had no product errors or warnings. dotnet build ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj --no-restore passed with 0 warnings/errors. git diff --check passed. Source inventory confirms one ShapeType mapping switch and one transform/symmetry metadata emission block.

Residual risk: broader full runtime/editor suites were not rerun because this slice is runtime-local; operation parity is covered for Sphere, Capsule, Box, Ellipsoid, mirrored rotated/scaled transforms.
